main.description: A principal's co-signature on an offer or amendment. Build Guild uses FULL per-person consent: an offer naming a multi-member party binds no one until the patron side AND every party[] member have each filed an acceptance (the offer's own author consents by authoring). So this record does double duty — a patron's accept means 'I agree to the deal'; a party member's accept means 'I consent to being on this party'; the verifier tells them apart by author. AGREED (or an amendment taking effect) = all current principals co-signed. Because `subject` is a strongRef (pinning the exact content id), terms can't be silently changed after acceptance: any change comes back as a new, separately-accepted amendment. Author is the accepter (repo owner). Written to the accepter's repo.

subject.description: The org.buildguild.offer or org.buildguild.amendment being co-signed (pinned by content id).

fetched.description: Optional git commit/tree sha the accepter has fetched and is acknowledging receipt of — forecloses 'I never received it' as a later defense (see org.buildguild.delivery).
